findings.label: Ventral penoscrotal web
findings.evidence: Webbed penis with a distorted penoscrotal angle.

panels.rationale: The image is a clinical photograph of a patient exhibiting webbed penis, which is the primary focus of the figure and text. The caption explicitly identifies the condition and a distorted penoscrotal angle is visible.
panels.attribution_text: Yesildag. It is not "Just Circumcision".. Pakistan journal of medical sciences 2015. doi:10.12669/pjms.314.7689. CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Figure 1.
panels.figure_caption: Webbed penis with a distorted penoscrotal angle.
in_text_mentions: The web excision together with circumcision was performed in cases with webbed penis. Fig.1 shows a patient with a penoscrotal webbing. Penile degloving and excision of the fibrous bands over the penile shaft were sufficient to correct chordee in nine patients but dorsal plication was carried on in one boy. The ventral curvature in a patient is showed in Fig.2.
